subject: CRITICAL: Production API returning 500 errors after upgrade
body:
Hello Support Team,

Our production environment is currently failing with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error whenever we query the /v2/orders endpoint. This started immediately following your 03:00 UTC maintenance window.

This is blocking all of our customer checkouts! We are losing thousands of dollars every hour. We need this escalated to your senior on-call engineering team IMMEDIATELY.

Account ID: ACC-94821
Error Code: ERR_SRV_500_TIMEOUT

Please treat this as an emergency ASAP!



--
Sarah Jenkins
VP of Infrastructure, Enterprise IO
Mobile: +1-555-019-2834
CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This transmission may contain privileged and confidential information.

subject: Charged twice on invoice INV-88231
body:
Hi there,

I was reviewing my credit card statement this morning and noticed two separate charges of $149.00 on September 28th for Invoice #INV-88231.

Could you please check this double billing and process a refund of $149.00 back to my card? I only subscribed to one monthly seat.

Thanks,
Marcus Vance

subject: Request for full refund - Service does not meet GDPR requirements
body:
Dear Support,

We recently purchased the Annual Business Plan on order ORD-554219 ($1,200.00). However, during our compliance audit, we found that data residency controls do not comply with our internal GDPR standards.

Per your 30-day money-back guarantee, we are requesting a full refund of $1,200.00 to our original payment method and closure of the subscription.

Thank you for your prompt handling.

Kind regards,
Elena Rostova
Data Protection Officer

subject: Locked out of my account - 2FA code not arriving
body:
Hi Support,

I am trying to log into my account (david.kim@outlook.com, User ID: USR-44102), but the SMS 2-factor authentication codes are not arriving on my phone (+1-555-0129). I have tried resending 4 times already.

I need to access my dashboard today to download our quarterly tax reports. Can you help me reset my 2FA or provide backup recovery codes?

Best,
David Kim

Sent from my iPhone

subject: Shipment damaged upon delivery - Tracking #TRK-8812903
body:
Hello,

We received shipment #TRK-8812903 today via DHL. Unfortunately, the outer crate was crushed and 3 of the 10 sensors are broken and unusable.

We have photos of the damage. Please arrange an immediate replacement dispatch for the 3 units so our deployment timeline is not delayed.

Thank you,
Carlos Mendez

subject: Cancel subscription effective immediately
body:

Please cancel our Team Plan subscription for account ACC-33109 effective at the end of the current billing cycle (October 15, 2026).

subject: Question regarding API rate limits and webhook retries
body:
Hello team,

I am evaluating your developer tier for an upcoming client project. I was wondering what the default rate limits are for the REST API (requests per minute), and if webhooks automatically retry upon receiving 5xx responses.

Also, do you offer sandbox test keys before subscribing?

Cheers,
Brian Connor
